PlaylistImageSnippet.description: A *playlistImage* resource identifies another resource, such as a image, that is associated with a playlist. In addition, the playlistImage resource contains details about the included resource that pertain specifically to how that resource is used in that playlist. YouTube uses playlists to identify special collections of videos for a channel, such as: * uploaded videos * favorite videos * positively rated (liked) videos * watch history To be more specific, these lists are associated with a channel, which is a collection of a person, group, or company's videos, playlists, and other YouTube information. You can retrieve the playlist IDs for each of these lists from the [`channel resource`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/channels) for a given channel. You can then use the [`playlistImages.list`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistImages/list) method to retrieve image data for any of those playlists. You can also add or remove images from those lists by calling the [`playlistImages.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistImages/insert) and [`playlistImages.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistImages/delete) methods.

YouTube uses playlists to identify special collections of videos for a channel, such as: * uploaded videos * favorite videos * positively rated (liked) videos * watch history * watch later To be more specific, these lists are associated with a channel, which is a collection of a person, group, or company's videos, playlists, and other YouTube information. You can retrieve the playlist IDs for each of these lists from the [`channel resource`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/channels) for a given channel. You can then use the [`playlistItems.list`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/list) method to retrieve any of those lists. You can also add or remove items from those lists by calling the [`playlistItems.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/insert) and [`playlistItems.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/playlistItems/delete) methods. targeting.description: The targeting object contains basic targeting settings about the channel section.

contentDetails.description: The contentDetails object contains details about the channel section content, such as a list of playlists or channels featured in the section.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "youtube#channelSection".

snippet.description: The snippet object contains basic details about the channel section, such as its type, style and title.

Caption.description: A *caption* resource represents a YouTube caption track. A caption track is associated with exactly one YouTube video.

snippet.description: The snippet object contains basic details about the caption.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "youtube#caption".

id.description: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the caption track.

hasPaidProductPlacement.description: This boolean represents whether the video contains Paid Product Placement, Studio equivalent: https://screenshot.googleplex.com/4Me79DE6AfT2ktp.png

linkingToken.description: The linking_token identifies a YouTube account and channel with which the third party account is linked.

snippet.description: The snippet object contains basic details about the third- party account link.

status.description: The status object contains information about the status of the link.

ThirdPartyLink.description: A *third party account link* resource represents a link between a YouTube account or a channel and an account on a third-party service.

ActivityContentDetailsSocial.description: Details about a social network post.

type.description: The name of the social network.

resourceId.description: The `resourceId` object encapsulates information that identifies the resource associated with a social network post.

referenceUrl.description: The URL of the social network post.

author.description: The author of the social network post.

imageUrl.description: An image of the post's author.

CommentThreadSnippet.description: Basic details about a comment thread.

channelId.description: The YouTube channel the comments in the thread refer to or the channel with the video the comments refer to. If neither video_id nor post_id is set the comments refer to the channel itself.

isPublic.description: Whether the thread (and therefore all its comments) is visible to all YouTube users.

canReply.description: Whether the current viewer of the thread can reply to it. This is viewer specific - other viewers may see a different value for this field.

totalReplyCount.description: The total number of replies (not including the top level comment).

videoId.description: The ID of the video the comments refer to, if any.

topLevelComment.description: The top level comment of this thread.

startAt.description: The time, measured in seconds from the start of the video, when the video should start playing. (The playlist owner can specify the times when the video should start and stop playing when the video is played in the context of the playlist.) The default value is 0.

endAt.description: The time, measured in seconds from the start of the video, when the video should stop playing. (The playlist owner can specify the times when the video should start and stop playing when the video is played in the context of the playlist.) By default, assume that the video.endTime is the end of the video.

videoId.description: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify a video. To [retrieve the `video` resource](https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/videos/list), set the id query parameter to this value in your API request.

note.description: A user-generated note for this item.

videoPublishedAt.description: The date and time that the video was published to YouTube.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "youtube#videoTrainability".

permitted.description: Specifies who is allowed to train on the video. Valid values are: - a single string "all" - a single string "none" - a list of allowed parties

VideoTrainability.description: Specifies who is allowed to train on the video.

PageInfo.description: Paging details for lists of resources, including total number of items available and number of resources returned in a single page.

totalResults.description: The total number of results in the result set.

resultsPerPage.description: The number of results included in the API response.

memberLevelName.description: The name of the Level at which the viewer is a member. This matches the `snippet.membershipGiftingDetails.giftMembershipsLevelName` of the associated membership gifting message. The Level names are defined by the YouTube channel offering the Membership. In some situations this field isn't filled.

associatedMembershipGiftingMessageId.description: The ID of the membership gifting message that is related to this gift membership. This ID will always refer to a message whose type is `membershipGiftingEvent`.

gifterChannelId.description: The ID of the user that made the membership gifting purchase. This matches the `snippet.authorChannelId` of the associated membership gifting message.
